hooks.text: Every fifty-two years, the Aztecs extinguished every single fire in their empire.
Would the sun rise again after the priests cut open the captive?
To keep the world alive, the empire plunged itself into total darkness.

title: Why Did the Aztecs Put Out Every Fire in 1507? 😳
description: In 1507, the Aztec Empire extinguished every flame in Tenochtitlan and waited in darkness for a new fire to be lit inside a human sacrifice.
